items.title: Ed Allen Interview, 1961-01-14
items.q: after I got Mr. Treckfuss he gave the music... So he picked a band called the Gold Whistler Band and called me in the office and said, I like your work and I'm organized a lot, I want a band to go down... he put me in charge of 80 hours, and he goes to the band.

ctx.x: And what kind of music did you play? How was the actual music you played? Was it Bahia or

Red Music? No it was not music. The average musician on the same list never played Bahia. He didn't? Well he learned that along with his music. But as a musician could read. And to play a job like on the boat around you had to read something. Now we had a regular station around every week and he'd start playing all the street and played pop music. And after I got Mr. Treckfuss he gave the music. He'd see jazz music every week. Well that summer I worked on the boat all that summer in St. Louis with a guy named…
It was a talk of the time. They'd come out and see what that band was playing. Well what did the band sound like? Was it like Dixieland today would you say?
